before_action.text: 进入前先看一遍盆壁病变投影，切口长度要给深部操作留余地。
before_action.text_en: Review the projected pelvic sidewall lesion before entry. The incision must allow adequate deep access.

before_action.text: 圆刀片、电刀和长吸引头，准备进入。
before_action.text_en: Scalpel, cautery, and long suction tip, ready for entry.

after_resolution.text: 腹壁已打开，我把肠袢侧的牵开保持在最小必要幅度。
after_resolution.text_en: The abdominal wall is open. I'll keep bowel-side retraction to the minimum needed.

before_action.text: 我先护住移开的肠袢，侧壁空间不要靠硬拉来换。
before_action.text_en: I'll protect the displaced bowel loops. Don't gain sidewall space by forceful traction.

before_action.text: 长牵开器、湿垫和深部吸引已经换好。
before_action.text_en: Long retractors, moist pads, and deep suction are ready.

after_resolution.text: 髂血管和输尿管的大致走向有了，真正分离前还要逐段确认。
after_resolution.text_en: The likely courses of the iliac vessels and ureter are visible. Confirm each segment before dissection.

after_resolution.text: 深盆腔操作开始了，体位受压点和循环趋势我会继续查看。
after_resolution.text_en: Deep pelvic work is beginning. I'll keep checking pressure points and hemodynamic trends.

before_action.text: 黏连把正常腹膜层次拉偏了，先找能连续追踪的安全平面。
before_action.text_en: Adhesions distort the normal peritoneal planes. Find a safely traceable plane first.

before_action.text: 细剪、无创抓持钳和双极，深部纱布留在手边。
before_action.text_en: Fine scissors, atraumatic graspers, and bipolar cautery. Keep deep pads close by.

after_resolution.text: 释放的肠袢我先移到保护区，别让它们重新压回术野。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll move the released bowel loops into the protected area so they do not fall back into the field.

after_resolution.text: 备用吸引管已接好，长时间牵开需要的垫片也补齐了。
after_resolution.text_en: Backup suction is connected, and the pads needed for prolonged retraction are replenished.

before_action.text: 输尿管从这段组织旁经过，我会持续给它留出可辨认的边界。
before_action.text_en: The ureter passes beside this tissue. I'll keep its boundary identifiable.

before_action.text: 闭孔神经和深部神经束的方向也要一起确认，不能只追着肿瘤走。
before_action.text_en: Confirm the obturator nerve and deeper neural pathways as well. Don't follow the tumor alone.

after_resolution.text: 软血管环和精细神经剥离子在这里，接下来需要哪一组请直接说。
after_resolution.text_en: Soft vessel loops and fine neural dissectors are here. Call for the next set as needed.

after_resolution.text: 这个区域的操作需要保持平稳，我继续复核血流动力学变化。
after_resolution.text_en: This stage calls for steady conditions. I'll keep reviewing hemodynamic changes.

before_action.text: 病灶与髂血管的接触范围已明确，接下来得选好控制和重建顺序。
before_action.text_en: The lesion's contact with the iliac vessels is defined. We need to choose the control and reconstruction sequence.

before_action.text: 我可以维持近端视野，远端暴露是否扩大取决于你的方案。
before_action.text_en: I can maintain the proximal view. Whether we extend distal exposure depends on your plan.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的血管处理方案推进，两端控制条件都要保持可复核。
after_resolution.text_en: We'll follow the selected vascular plan. Both control zones must remain verifiable.

after_resolution.text: 血管夹、缝线和必要的移植物备用规格已核对。
after_resolution.text_en: Vascular clamps, sutures, and backup graft sizes have been checked.

before_action.text: 这里的髂血管壁与病灶贴得很紧，先确保近远端都有退路。
before_action.text_en: The iliac vessel wall adheres closely to the lesion. Secure proximal and distal options before proceeding.

before_action.text: 直角血管钳、细血管剪和血管环。
before_action.text_en: Right-angle vascular clamp, fine vascular scissors, and vessel loops.

before_action.text: 我维持远端控制区的视野，别让深部牵开把血管推向刀尖。
before_action.text_en: I'll maintain the distal control view. Don't let deep retraction push the vessel toward the instrument tip.

after_resolution.text: 我护住已经游离的血管段，深面牵拉要避开它。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll protect the freed vascular segment. Keep deeper traction away from it.

after_resolution.text: 血管操作阶段的失血与灌注趋势由我盯着，有变化马上通知。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll watch blood loss and perfusion trends during vascular work and report changes immediately.

before_action.text: 肿瘤深缘的牵拉会传到盆壁神经，我从外侧给你减一点张力。
before_action.text_en: Traction on the deep tumor margin reaches the pelvic nerves. I'll reduce tension from the lateral side.

before_action.text: 长柄双极、精细剪和小棉片，换到深部解剖器械。
before_action.text_en: Long bipolar forceps, fine scissors, and small pledgets. Switching to deep dissection tools.

after_resolution.text: 深部边界已经处理，切除床仍要按神经和血管方向逐面复查。
after_resolution.text_en: The deep margin is addressed. Review the resection bed surface by surface along the nerves and vessels.

after_resolution.text: 标本接收和方向标记已准备好，等主刀确认取出。
after_resolution.text_en: Specimen reception and orientation labels are ready, pending the surgeon's confirmation.

before_action.text: 取标本时注意和髂血管的最后连接点，别让重量带走残余组织。
before_action.text_en: When removing the specimen, watch its final attachment to the iliac vessels. Don't let its weight tear tissue.

before_action.text: 标本袋、托盘和冲洗液已经放到指定位置。
before_action.text_en: Specimen bag, tray, and irrigation are in their assigned positions.

after_resolution.text: 盆壁现在空出来了，我重新布置牵开，给血管吻合留出直线视野。
after_resolution.text_en: The sidewall is clear. I'll reset retraction for a direct view of the vascular anastomosis.

before_action.text: 重建段先比长度和旋转方向，太短会牵拉，太长会打折。
before_action.text_en: Check graft length and rotational alignment first. Too short creates tension; too long can kink.

before_action.text: 无损血管钳、血管缝线和小持针器。
before_action.text_en: Atraumatic vascular clamps, vascular sutures, and a small needle holder.

before_action.text: 移植物备用规格仍在手术间，使用哪一款请在开封前回读型号。
before_action.text_en: Backup graft sizes remain in the room. Please read back the model before opening one.

after_resolution.text: 我沿吻合口外围看一圈，再确认移植物没有被盆壁牵开器压住。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll inspect around the anastomosis and ensure the pelvic retractors are not compressing the graft.

after_resolution.text: 准备结合术野检查灌注变化，麻醉侧会同步复核循环指标。
after_resolution.text_en: We'll correlate field findings with perfusion changes while I review hemodynamic indices.

before_action.text: 闭孔神经和盆壁固定点已经重新显露，先确认没有线结跨过神经走行。
before_action.text_en: The obturator nerve and sidewall fixation points are exposed again. Ensure no knots cross the nerve path.

before_action.text: 精细探针、无创镊和补充止血材料。
before_action.text_en: Fine probe, atraumatic forceps, and additional hemostatic materials.

after_resolution.text: 神经周围的空间重新核对完毕，接下来复查血管通路和止血。
after_resolution.text_en: The space around the nerves has been rechecked. Next, review vascular flow and hemostasis.

after_resolution.text: 引流用品和关闭用物已在台外备好，暂不影响当前术野。
after_resolution.text_en: Drain and closure supplies are available outside the field without disturbing the current view.

before_action.text: 需要核对重建后的灌注反应，我会把当前循环趋势与术野结果对应起来。
before_action.text_en: We need to assess perfusion after reconstruction. I'll correlate current hemodynamic trends with the field findings.

before_action.text: 远端血流、移植物走向和深部渗血，三项要分开确认。
before_action.text_en: Distal flow, graft alignment, and deep oozing must be checked separately.

after_resolution.text: 按所选复核范围完成检查，若有疑点，关腹前就处理。
after_resolution.text_en: Complete the selected review. Any concerns must be addressed before abdominal closure.

after_resolution.text: 移植物型号和实用耗材逐项入记录，最终清点可以开始准备。
after_resolution.text_en: Graft details and supplies actually used are being logged. Final counting can be prepared.

before_action.text: 深部止血和引流位置最后确认一遍，我会维持盆壁视野到关闭开始。
before_action.text_en: One last check of deep hemostasis and drains. I'll maintain the sidewall view until closure begins.

before_action.text: 筋膜缝线、皮下缝线和关闭器械已经换好。
before_action.text_en: Fascial sutures, subcutaneous sutures, and closure instruments are ready.

after_resolution.text: 针、纱布与器械完成终末核对，植入物记录与转运单一起交接。
after_resolution.text_en: Final needle, sponge, and instrument counts are complete. Implant records accompany the transfer handoff.

after_resolution.text: 复苏团队会收到血管重建和神经保护的观察重点。
after_resolution.text_en: The recovery team will receive the vascular reconstruction and nerve-protection monitoring priorities.
